items.source: Create a new managed array placeholder.
items.translation: 创建一个新的托管数组占位符。

items.source: elementTypeName - the target element type as a class name
items.translation: elementTypeName - 目标元素类型作为类名

items.source:
Tag collection class used to hold managed array elements, which may
include runtime bean references (to be resolved into bean objects).
items.translation: 用于托管数组元素的标签集合类，其中可能包含运行时 Bean 引用（需解析为 Bean 对象）。
